notes: After a strictly verified Quick Check, prepare a complete customer-ready sentence in the selected or detected language. A matched successful deposit includes its MYR amount and exact backend confirmation time; an explicitly credited promotion includes its code and exact backend confirmation time.

Prepare the approved withdrawal wording for Payment closed and for a positive remaining turnover such as RM11. A calculated turnover amount requires one current unfinished promotion, matched deposit evidence, no newer pending deposit, no unfinished rebate, and no pagination or conflict.

Keep uncertain results safe: pending, unknown, missing-time, tied, mismatched, paginated or conflicting records prepare only the waiting/operator route. Every factual sentence is editable, rechecks the same chat and report fingerprints before Copy or Use, fills only an empty composer, and is never sent automatically.
